The '''TIE fighter combat medallion''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] medal awarded for completing basic training with [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE/LN starfighters]]. It had an engraving of a TIE/LN starfighter.

There were three versions of the medal, which differed only in the metal used to create it: [[Bronze/Legends|bronze]], [[Silver/Legends|silver]], and [[Gold/Legends|gold]]. The bronze version was awarded to pilots who completed training relating to the TIE/LN's basic weapons systems/dogfight capabilities as well as working within a squadron. The silver version was awarded to pilots who completed training relating to the above as well as a reenactment of an operation relating to the destruction of a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] depot. The gold version was presented to pilots who completed the above training operations as well as a reenactment of a mission to destroy a Rebel-aligned probe.

==Known recipients==
[[Maarek Stele/Legends|Maarek Stele]] received all three versions of this medal after completing the training ops relating to the TIE/LN when he was freshly recruited.
